name: gguf-cve-map
made_with: AI, by MV2 of Munim, Inc.
description: Maps the public GGUF parser memory-safety advisory cluster to the header field that overflows, the weakness class, and the gguf_scan rule that statically flags each precursor before loading.

CVE-2024-21825.impact: heap-based buffer overflow -> code execution on a crafted .gguf

CVE-2024-23496.impact: heap-based buffer overflow -> code execution on a crafted .gguf

CVE-2024-23605.impact: count*element integer overflow -> undersized alloc -> heap overflow

CVE-2025-53630.impact: integer overflow in size accumulation -> heap out-of-bounds read/write

CVE-2026-27940.component: llama.cpp mem_size calculation (bypass of the CVE-2025-53630 fix)
CVE-2026-27940.impact: integer overflow -> undersized heap allocation -> code execution

CVE-2026-33298.impact: tensor-size integer overflow -> heap out-of-bounds access

CVE-2026-108955.impact: out-of-bounds read via unchecked tensor data offset

corpus.precursor: declared metadata KV count far exceeds the bytes present
declared tensor count drives an oversized size accumulation
array element count times element size overflows the allocation
declared string length runs past the end of the file
product of tensor dimensions overflows the 64-bit element count
alignment is zero (not a nonzero power of two) -> GGML_PAD hazard
corpus.note: defense-in-depth: no numbered CVE; mirrors public GGML_PAD/alignment hardening

corpus.precursor: tensor data offset points past the end of the file
corpus.note: GG011 flags the unaligned offset; full data-region bounds checking is a documented gap
